What constitutes agency? With the rise of Large Language Model (LLM) systems marketed as ``coding agents'', ``AI co-scientists'', and other ``agentic\\\" tools that promise to drive up productivity, and at the same time, ``existential\\\" concerns such as AI escaping human control with destructive power under a speculative ``machine agency\\\" against humans, it has become essential to clarify where automation ends and agency begins, both for building capable systems and for understanding whether and what to fear.
